payload.title: Freeze residual sequence-state worth screen
payload.decision: Run T023 only as the preregistered worth screen in tracking/evidence/T023/config.json. No GRU, TCN, HMM extension, PF extension, new path model, or deployment package may be implemented unless a legal sequence proxy passes the frozen advancement gates. Hidden-label oracle paths are diagnostic only.
payload.rationale: E011 leaves large path-bank headroom, but E012 and T022 show that well-level specialization and routing do not identify safe action. A materially new row-sequence representation must first demonstrate capacity, legal learnability, repeated-cell stability, shift transfer, and failed negative controls.
payload.revisit_trigger: Only after T023 completes every registered repeated branch, required stress branch, control, edge group, and independent reproduction.
